name: Claim: DeepSeek DSV4.1 Flash decode reaches 90 tok/s on an M5 Ultra with TensorFold, up from 70
title: Claim: DeepSeek DSV4.1 Flash decode reaches 90 tok/s on an M5 Ultra with TensorFold, up from 70
summary: A builder reports the roughly 475 GB official DSV4.1 Flash weights decoding at 90 tokens per second on an M5 Ultra with the TensorFold runtime, versus 70 in an earlier post. No method, settings or run log are given in this post.
